items.expectedText: I usually check the timetable before I travel. Today I am waiting at the main terminal with a small suitcase. My destination is a town by the sea, but there is a delay. I am checking the new departure time and listening to the announcement. My ticket is valid on a direct service, so I do not need a transfer. I am asking the conductor about a seat reservation near the luggage space. My friend is meeting me at the station this afternoon. I am sending her the new arrival time so that she does not have to wait too long. Before I board, I will check the platform display once more.

items.expectedText: I would like to have a picnic with my friends near a lake in spring. I will check the weather forecast the night before and again in the morning. I think the day will be warm, but it might be windy. If I see a dark cloud, I will take an umbrella. If it is going to rain, we will use a nearby cafe instead of sitting outside. We will go indoors immediately if we hear thunder or see lightning. I enjoy sunshine, but a little rain will not end our plan. The important thing is to tell everyone both meeting places before they leave home. Then nobody needs to wait in the wrong place.

items.expectedText: I have tried several activities in my leisure time, but my favorite hobby is volleyball. I first played it with friends last year at a small gym. I have never joined a serious competition, and I do not worry much about the score. I enjoy exercise more when everyone helps the team. A coach showed us how to pass the ball safely, and the center provided the equipment. I have also watched a match as a spectator, which gave me some ideas for practice. I would like to cycle to the gym next time, so I will wear a helmet. My goal is to improve my fitness and enjoy time with friends.

items.expectedText: I would like to prepare a document for my local club. First, I connect my device to a wireless network and open a browser. Then I visit the club website and use my own account. I type the notes with the keyboard and save a file in a folder. Before I upload the document, I check the date and the place. After I upload it, I look for the correct file name online. If the internet is unavailable, my offline copy still opens. I do not share my password in an email. When I finish, I use the logout button so that the next person cannot use my account.

I would like to do research about my neighborhood and write a report. I work during the day, so I want to avoid studying too late. I will finish my homework in two short sessions each week. items.expectedText: I would like my community to organize a cleanup beside a river. The place is a habitat for wildlife, and litter can harm animals that live there. First, the path is checked by a local guide. Then rubbish is collected by volunteers wearing gloves. Clean metal cans and accepted plastic bottles are put into separate boxes for recycling. We can also reduce waste by bringing our own water bottles. After the cleanup, the group could reuse old wood to make signs asking visitors to keep the path clean. This action will not solve all pollution, but it may help people care for the environment. I hope children and adults can work together and continue the habit.
